procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose) and the scan is the low-DPI fax family, so doubtful glyphs were re-checked at 500 dpi where needed (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/holmes/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (13/13).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 3rd); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 16 precincts (11 columns, then Beat 4 Thornton (A-Z)/Beat 4 Walden Chapel (A-Z)/Beat 5 Cruger (A-Z)/Beat 5 Lexington (A-Z)/Beat 5 Tchula + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying ONLY the Circuit 22 section (its own header opens the table, no carry). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald); Chancery Court 11-1-Chancery District 11-1 (Robert G. Clark III, sole candidate); 'Chancery Court 11 Place 3-Chancery District 11 Place 3' (the sheet's own slightly different label form for the Place 3 section: Gene D. Berry, David Bridges, Alan Rhea); Circuit Court 22-Circuit District 22 (Tim Howard, Akillie Malone Oliver -- the same race and roster Humphreys prints, names identical, no Place qualifier). Printed totals: Colom 5688, Hyde-Smith 848, Pinkins 82, Eller 818, G. Thompson 5644, Foster 147, McDonald 5107, Clark III 6019, Berry 1906, Bridges 2359, Rhea 1435, Howard 4508, Oliver 1954.
operator_rows_note: All 13 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (five precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Howard's and Oliver's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the sixteen precinct headers print complete ('1 Acona', '1 Durant St Anderson', 'Beat 1 Lexington', 'Beat 2 Durant', 'Beat 2 Sub Durant', 'Beat 2 West', 'Beat 3 Coxburg (A-Z)', 'Beat 3 Ebenezer', 'Beat 3 Goodman', 'Beat 3 Pickens', 'Beat 4 Lexington', 'Beat 4 Thornton (A-Z)', 'Beat 4 Walden Chapel (A-Z)', 'Beat 5 Cruger (A-Z)', 'Beat 5 Lexington (A-Z)', 'Beat 5 Tchula' -- the sheet's own split-registration suffixes kept verbatim).
local_note: No local sections print on this five-page sheet at all -- the row stream ends at Circuit 22's two rows (the election commissioners' certification signatures are on p1); the sheet-scope observation is recorded per the source-fidelity convention. Chancery 11's printed Places are 1 and 3 (no Place 2 section), so the family writes 'Chancery Court Place 1'/'Chancery Court Place 3'; Circuit 22's single no-Place race keeps the bare 'Circuit Court' label (matching Humphreys').
